model_output.rationale: CO-29 timely filing denial. 837P envelope is dated 2025-10-15 (~9 months after DOS 2025-01-19), which would be late under most commercial filing limits. However, the 277CA carries received date 2025-01-27 — only 8 days post-DOS — and shares trace TRC75364521 with the October 837P. A 277CA cannot predate its 837P; one date is wrong. If a prior submission was accepted on or near 2025-01-27, that acceptance report is proof of timely filing and the CO-29 is appealable. Without that answer the disposition cannot be determined.

awaiting_human.question: Was a claim for DOS 2025-01-19 submitted to Liberty Bell Health Plans and accepted by the clearinghouse before 2025-10-15? The 277CA shows received date 2025-01-27 but the 837P envelope is dated 2025-10-15 — these cannot both be correct for the same transaction. Confirm: (a) is the 277CA date a data entry error (should it be ~2025-10-27?), or (b) was there an earlier submission accepted on 2025-01-27 with a separate clearinghouse acceptance report?
awaiting_human.why_needed: If a prior submission was accepted on 2025-01-27, that acceptance report is proof of timely filing and CO-29 is appealable. If the 277CA date is erroneous and the only submission was October 2025, the claim is likely genuinely late and must be written off.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 on both lines; 837P submission date 2025-10-15 is ~9 months after DOS 2025-01-19. 277CA date 2025-01-27 contradicts the 837P envelope date — cannot confirm timely filing without clarification.

next_action.detail: Pending answer above: if prior timely submission confirmed → appeal CO-29 with acceptance report. If only submission was October 2025 → do_not_resubmit, write off $138.62.

evidence.fact: Both lines carry CO-29; MOA N211. Billed $138.62, paid $0.
837P interchange envelope dated 2025-10-15, ~269 days after DOS 2025-01-19.
277CA received date 2025-01-27, trace TRC75364521 — same trace as the October 837P. Chronologically impossible for one transaction.
CO-29 genuinely late → do_not_resubmit; proof of clearinghouse acceptance inside the window → appeal.

citations.rule: Proof of timely filing: clearinghouse acceptance report is strongest; if late and no exception → do_not_resubmit, CO = provider liable.
